items.title: Verde Árido
items.subtitle: Intelligence and Sustainability in the Semi-Arid Region
items.summary: Agtech platform for forage cactus management and livestock nutrition in Brazil's semi-arid region.
items.context: 14th Edition of Campus Mobile — Instituto Claro / USP
items.description: Verde Árido is an Agtech platform designed to strengthen livestock farming in Brazil's semi-arid region, selected for the 14th edition of Campus Mobile. We worked on technology-driven forage cactus management and precision livestock nutrition, reducing producers' vulnerability to drought. The solution uses geolocation and data such as the Agricultural Climate Risk Zoning to support decision-making in the field, serving both rural producers and agricultural consulting firms with a scalable business model. The core goal is simple: keep farmers on the land and reduce rural exodus.

image.alt: Verde Árido app interface showing the forage cactus monitoring dashboard in the semi-arid region

items.title: Guardiões da Bandeira
items.subtitle: Our Childhood, Turned Into a Game
items.summary: Mobile strategy game based on Brazilian folklore, adapting the game 'Capture the Flag' for digital play.
items.context: Game Dev Quest — Paraíba Game Incentive Circuit
items.description: Guardiões da Bandeira is a mobile strategy and adventure game selected for Game Dev Quest. We adapted the popular Brazilian game 'Capture the Flag' into a competitive digital environment rooted in local folklore. The interface was designed around limited-vision and tactical-movement mechanics, keeping navigation intuitive during cooperative matches. The visual identity uses stylized 2D art featuring folkloric characters and special powers, along with a progression system, individual rankings, and a soundtrack inspired by Brazilian rhythms.

image.alt: Guardiões da Bandeira game screen showing a tactical map with characters from Brazilian folklore

items.title: RePlast3D
items.subtitle: 1st Place — Intercollegiate Competition
items.summary: Turning the institution's plastic waste into filament for 3D printing.
items.description: Project awarded 1st place in the intercollegiate competition at IFPB's Technology Week. The proposal turns plastic waste generated by the institution itself into filament for 3D printing, for use in prototyping labs. The judging panel highlighted the feasibility analysis and environmental impact potential as the strongest points of the work — an example of how reusing materials can meet real technical needs at low cost.

image.alt: RePlast3D project presentation showing the process of turning recycled plastic into 3D printing filament

items.title: Plot Twist Club
items.subtitle: Visual Identity
items.summary: Visual identity for an IFPB outreach project focused on making cinema more accessible.
items.description: Plot Twist Club is an IFPB outreach project focused on making cinema more accessible and encouraging critical thinking among public school students and the local community. With free weekly screenings focused on Brazilian films, it fosters discussions connecting the works to social, historical, and civic issues. I developed the project's visual identity, from the initial concept to the final version.

image.alt: Plot Twist Club visual identity featuring graphic elements related to cinema and culture

items.title: Pod Adm
items.subtitle: Management and Local Entrepreneurship Podcast
items.summary: Podcast and visual identity connecting local business owners with the community of Lavras da Mangabeira.
items.context: Final Project, Technical Degree in Administration — EEEP
items.description: Final project for the Technical Degree in Administration, made as a team, to connect local business owners with the community of Lavras da Mangabeira (CE). Pod Adm turned conversations about management into accessible content, featuring real stories from local entrepreneurs. I handled the project's visual identity and social media management (Instagram and YouTube) to expand the reach of its content.
